_about: The one background catalogue. `tools/generate-backgrounds.mjs` turns it into the launcher's `backgrounds.generated.ts` and the game's `BackgroundCatalog.java`; `crates/launcher-desktop/src/lib.rs` tests its allowlist against it; `tools/prepare-background-library.mjs` builds every still, thumbnail and scene from it. Launcher paths are under desktop/public/, Minecraft paths under textures/menu/. `width`/`height` are the asset's native pixels. `minecraft.video` names a frame sequence the game can play; otherwise the game shows `minecraft.still`.
